newsitem.title: INDIA: Germany's Haake-Beck in India beer venture.
newsitem.headline: Germany's Haake-Beck in India beer venture.

text.p: India's Him Neel Breweries Ltd and Germany's Haake-Beck Brauerie AG have set up a 550 million rupee ($15.4 million) brewery in northern India, the United News of India (UNI) said on Monday.
The news agency said the beer will be marketed under the Haake-Beck brand name and would be available in India from next month.

UNI said the brewery would have a capacity to produce 150,000 hectolitres of beer a year. The beer would be produced in two categories -- strong and mild -- and will be available in 625- and 325-millilitre bottles, it said.
Analysts estimate the size of the Indian beer market to be 55 million cases (12 bottles of 650 ml) annually, worth 15 billion rupees.
Apart from Haake-Beck, several other beer giants are in various stages of launching their brands in India.
Some of these are Anheuser-Busch Cos Inc, Denmark's Carlsberg A/S, Germany's Henninger-Braeu AG, Philippines' San Miguel Corp, South African Breweries and Japan's Kirin Brewery Company Ltd.
